title: Conquer the self and return to ritual
subtitle: Analects, Yan Yuan chapter
timeLabel: Analects chapter and Tang classical-learning context
shortSummary: The line connects humaneness with self-restraint and ritual practice, and was repeatedly reinterpreted in political and educational settings.
curatorialDescription: ‘Conquer the self and return to ritual’ is more than private moral advice. It connects body, ritual, education and political order and opens onto the institutional life of Confucian concepts.
researchNote: The Alpha entry begins with a chapter locator; commentaries, variants and Tang classical-learning contexts remain to be added.

quote.interpretation: In the context of the Yan Yuan chapter, humaneness is connected with self-restraint and the practice of ritual; it is not an abstract goodwill outside relationships and institutions.

profile.translationEn: To restrain the self and return to ritual is humaneness.
